_doc: Edge-score weights for the Path C reduced-ambition commander recommendation layer (Phase 2). Weighted combiner over 3 axes: primitives_overlap (Jaccard-like overlap of the candidate's primitives_json with the seed's), color_efficiency (color identity match against seed colors with exact-match bonus), power_marker_density (GAME_CHANGERS_SET membership signal). Theme_match + commander_role bracket-tier filter intentionally OMITTED in Path C — deferred to Phase 2.1 once curated metadata lands.
